plugin.name: The Godfather Fusion Fix
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay view on top of widescreen correction, up to 150 degrees horizontally. 1.0 keeps the intended view. Aim, authored zooms and camera transitions keep their own lens.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla keeps the original optional behavior. Recommended applies the default improvements. Enhanced enables all available improvements. Essential fixes stay on in every preset.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu (this fix and other plugins). Automatic follows the game.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a framed window, or a borderless window. Restart to apply.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Release it while unfocused or while the developer overlay is open.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause simulation while the game window is inactive. Turning this off keeps the game running in the background. Manual pause is preserved.
update.availablehub: An update for The Godfather Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for The Godfather Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keep the game's sliding top and bottom borders. Off switches them instantly.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original Aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup logo sequence. Story movies and bonus videos still play. Applies the next time the intro starts.
FPSLimit.description: Limit the render rate while keeping simulation timing correct. Use 0 for unlimited, -1 for the monitor refresh rate, or 30–1000 FPS.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places complete health, target, weapon and radar groups at the screen edges. Enter a ratio such as 4:3 or 16:9 to place them inside a centered box. Sizes and proportions stay unchanged. Menus, subtitles and full-screen effects keep their own layout. Ratios are limited to 4:3–32:9 and the screen width.
VSync.description: Synchronizes presentation with the monitor to avoid tearing. On can limit the frame rate to the monitor refresh rate. Turn it off to use higher FPS limits. Requires a game restart.
GamepadIcons.description: Selects the controller button artwork. Automatic uses Xbox icons; choose PlayStation or Nintendo manually. Keyboard and mouse prompts keep their own labels.
GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Scales right-stick camera speed after the game's response curve. 1.0 keeps the original speed. Keyboard, mouse, movement and menu input keep their own behavior.
InvertGamepadY.description: Reverses vertical right-stick camera motion. Mouse inversion uses the game's own option.
Vibration.description: Plays the game's controller vibration through the bundled Xidi driver. Stops while paused or unfocused, and as soon as this option is turned off.
